title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1936. inv. no 831 (1-700) from the Mosque of Ali Pasha, Tokat. 235 x 600 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 59.
